labels: The plantation site possess the relevant growth parameters and is suitable for the cultivation of Oil Palm, specifically:
-Temperature varies from a maximum of 34.9°C to a minimum of 20°C
- Yearly rainfall is more than the required minimum amount of 1,800 mm, averaging at 3,485 mm for the past 5 years
- However, rain distribution is uneven as there is a 2/3-month dry period with a water deficit > 300 mm
- Sunshine hours is above the required amount of 1,800 hours per year
Overall, the soil is of sandy clay loam texture. It is deep, homogenous, porous, friable and loose which is typical of inland mineral soils and highly suitable for Oil Palm cultivation
The plantation land has a flat to undulating terrain and comprises of a contiguous plot
All housing infrastructure for Staff and labourers will be built at the plantation
The Mill cost is all-inclusive including civil works and project management fees
The plantation is following best plantation management practices introduced by AgriNexus and hence, optimal yield profiles can be achieved

AgriNexus International is the turnkey plantation operators for the project and will second a full-time qualified Plantation General Manager & Mill Manager on-site to manage the day-to-day operations and closely monitored by a team of Experts from Agrinexus' HQ in Malaysia
High Conservation Value (HCV) set-aside costs has been included to be in line with RSPO requirements and best management practices

This model is for OCTAVUS PLANTATIONS (SL) LIMITED's 15,000 hectare Oil Palm plantation project in Port Loko, North West Province, Sierra Leone. The end products comprise of Crude Palm Oil (CPO), Palm Kernel Oil (PKO) and Palm Kernel Cake. The business requires an investment of approximately USD 135.5 million to develop the entire plantation (i.e. Cost to Maturity + Capital Expenditure). The development costs are incurred in the initial 7 years of the plantation. The projected IRR for the project is about 24% over the 27 year cycle of the investment and the ROI for this project is 12.68 years.
